basics.name: Aryuth Ekkul
basics.label: AI-Augmented Principal Engineer
basics.summary: I am a principal engineer with 14 years of backend experience, and I use AI agents to deliver business results faster. At Crossover (Trilogy), I build the systems behind an AI-driven hiring platform that handles about 700,000 applications a year. My work automates candidate screening, gives pipeline managers direct access to the data they act on, and helps fill hard-to-staff roles. My team and I built an AI-first way of working that lets a small team ship with high autonomy, much faster than before. Before that, I built fintech services for millions of users at EarnIn and an adaptive learning platform for Alpha School. I mentor engineers on AI-first delivery. I am looking for a principal or staff backend role with an international team in Bangkok.

work.name: Trilogy (Crossover)
work.summary: Core engineer on Crossover, Trilogy's AI-driven hiring platform (~700k applications per year). Stack: TypeScript, AWS Lambda, Salesforce Apex, PostgreSQL, React, Claude / Bedrock.
highlights: Replaced manual candidate screening with an AI interview that assesses every applicant against the role's requirements, so hiring managers spend time only on qualified candidates.
Helped turn a small team into an AI-first delivery unit that ships product changes with high autonomy, much faster than two years ago.
Gave pipeline managers and AI agents self-serve, secure access to live hiring data, so they act on data more easily and without an engineer.
Built candidate-to-seat matching and daily outreach that help fill hard-to-staff campus roles.
Mentored and onboarded 5+ engineers and product managers into AI-first ways of working.

work.name: EarnIn
work.summary: Earned-wage-access fintech with millions of users. Stack: C#, Kotlin, TypeScript.
highlights: Built and maintained the bank-connection services that link users' bank accounts through Plaid, and reduced production incidents in this money-critical path.
Built the External Data Exchange (EDX) services that move earnings and pay data between EarnIn and payroll partners.
Maintained the User service, the core account service behind the app, and shared on-call for production incidents.

work.name: Trilogy
work.summary: Stack: TypeScript, AWS serverless (Lambda, AppSync, Cognito, Aurora Serverless MySQL, Athena, Glue, S3, QuickSight), AWS CDK.
highlights: Built the backend of Alpha Coachbot, the adaptive learning platform that Alpha School used with ~400 students. It combined Khan Academy, IXL, Duolingo and other apps into one personal learning plan per student, so coaches could see and steer each student's progress.
Delivered serverless AWS services with a distributed global team, with automated releases that shortened the path from idea to production.
Set coding standards and a quality plan for a large legacy codebase, which reduced rework and kept delivery predictable.

work.name: Biggest Fan Productions
highlights: Led a two-way concert-streaming platform that kept live music income going during COVID. Performers and ~400 viewers interacted in real time with 150 ms latency.
Mentored a team of about 20 developers.
Led the company's pivot to blockchain products, including a multi-chain NFT project.
work.summary: Stack: C++, Python, V4L2, CUDA, PostgreSQL, Web3.

work.name: HotNow (acquired Proteus Technologies)
highlights: Led a squad of 6-8 developers, 2-3 testers and a product owner.
Built the multi-tenant login, inventory and accounting services that let the company serve many merchants on one platform.
Led the integration of the acquired Proteus systems, so the merged company ran on one platform.
work.summary: Stack: Python, C++, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, Helm, Jenkins, GitLab CI.

work.name: Proteus Technologies
highlights: Led the billing system for a major Southeast Asian e-commerce company, which processed 2M+ transactions per week.
Grew from frontend developer to backend technical lead across 8 client projects in HR, travel, legal tech and fulfilment.
work.summary: Stack: Python, Django, React, Angular, PostgreSQL, Docker.

work.name: OgilvyOne Worldwide
highlights: Built a Coca-Cola Facebook app that went viral with millions of Thai users.

work.name: United Technology for Alliance
